help.type: http downloads a rule file from a URL; file reads a local file; inline writes the rule list directly into the config.
help.behavior: domain: DOMAIN-SUFFIX-style entries. ipcidr: IP-CIDR-style entries. classical: any rule type, one per line. Not every (format, behavior) combination is supported — see "format" below.
help.format: yaml/text: source formats, convertible with each other. mrs: Mihomo's compact binary format — only supports domain/ipcidr behavior, not classical.
help.path: For type: http, the local cache file location (optional, auto-generated if left empty); for type: file, the actual source file — required.
help.proxy: The node or policy group used to dial the rule file download itself; leave empty to download directly.
help.payload: type: inline only; writes rule entries directly into the config, one string per line, interpreted according to "behavior".
rule.mrsFormatExcludesClassicalBehavior: The mrs format only supports domain and ipcidr behavior, not classical — pick domain or ipcidr, or switch format to yaml/text.
